name: FLIXO Agent cancels a prepared plan without executing a tool
description: The cancellation command must clear the prepared execution state and prevent tool execution.

planSteps.description: Enter `compress this image under 200KB and convert to WebP` in the FLIXO Agent command field
Verify the plan-ready card is visible
Enter `cancel` in the command field and send the message
Verify the Agent reports that the plan was cancelled
Verify the plan-ready card is no longer displayed
Verify no result preview is displayed
